name: Evaluate a program expression
short_description: Trace one short expression with variables and state its resulting value.
self_assessment: I can evaluate five short program expressions without help and state each result.
description: Trace one short expression with variables and state its resulting value. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.

builds_on.note: File organisation supports working with source files.
